checks.expected: The New supplier onboarding request heading, landmarks, controls, required state, and instructions are announced in a meaningful order.
Operating organization, names, country, ownership, supplier type, and qualification type expose their labels, selected values, required state, and validation errors.
Validation outcome, Submit for approval availability, and Pending Approval status are discoverable without visual-only cues.
The Workflow section exposes the definition, work item, task owner, task status, and task version with understandable relationships.
Approve opens from the keyboard; focus enters the dialog; its name, reason requirement, error, buttons, Escape close, and focus restoration are announced.
Verify with MFA, the authenticator prompt, errors, successful return, and restored approval context are understandable with the screen reader.
Approved and Applied state changes and Create Business Partner completion are discoverable without relying on color or toast placement.
Result coordinates, snapshot summary, lineage list, and the bounded-evidence explanation have useful headings and reading order.
The record identity, role lens, Roles & scope, Supplier role, Procurement & AP, and Accounts payable configuration are operable and announced.
At 200% zoom and at 1440x900 and 412x915 viewports, reading order and keyboard focus remain usable without hidden controls or two-dimensional content scrolling.

reviewAttestation.statement: I performed these checks with the named real assistive technology and browser and recorded every observed failure or pass.
